name: PrimeTurf
tagline: Premium artificial turf, supplied and installed by our own team.
description: Premium artificial turf supply and installation across Gauteng and the Western Cape. Zero water, UV-stabilised and fully drained. Every project scoped, supplied and installed by our own team.

promises.siteVisit: Same-day site visits available across Gauteng

warranty.statement: Every PrimeTurf installation carries a 6-year manufacturer’s product warranty and a 24-month workmanship / installation guarantee.

pricing.statement: Fully installed ranges typically R450–R850 per m², depending on turf grade and site preparation. Indicative only — confirmed after a site visit.

forms._comment: Set endpoint to a form backend (Formspree, Basin, a Vercel function, etc.). When empty, forms fall back to WhatsApp / email hand-off.

visualiser._comment: Set apiBase to your deployed AI endpoint (see /api and README). Empty = fully client-side concept overlay.
